title: Climate Change, Climate Policy, and Trade
venue: Handbook of the Economics of Climate Change

title: Assessing the Aggregate Price Effects of Trade Using the Food Engel Curve
A Framework for Integrating Climate Goals into Trade Agreements
abstract: A critical tension in global governance is that trade agreements have evolved largely in isolation from climate policy. This paper shows that the two domains generate systematic cross-externalities: larger gains from trade are associated with greater climate externalities imposed on partners, while linking carbon taxes to trade agreements produces distributive externalities that undermine the balance of trade concessions. To address this tension, we present a framework to integrate harmonized carbon pricing into the WTO subject to institutional and political-feasibility constraints. We explore two linkage designs. The first is a centralized Climate Fund, where all members apply a common demand-side carbon tax and contribute a portion of the revenues to the fund, capped by fiscal constraints. The Fund then reallocates these contributions to balance the tax burden across countries, subject to informational constraints. Quantitative analysis shows that even a simple fund allocation rule can sustain a carbon price of $138 per ton of CO2, reducing global emissions by 54%.The main binding constraint is informational: knowing the precise incidence of the carbon tax across countries ex ante would raise the feasible price to $265.The second is a decentralized design without transfers. Each member meets a carbon tax revenue floor but retains full discretion over its mix of demand-side and supply-side taxes. Energy exporters choose supply-side taxes while energy importers opt for demand-side taxes. These choices organically balance the tax burden and yield a 47% reduction in global emissions, almost rivaling the centralized Climate Fund.
abstract_zh: 全球治理中的一个关键张力在于，贸易协定在很大程度上与气候政策相互独立地演进。本文表明，这两个领域会产生系统性的交叉外部性：更大的贸易收益往往伴随着对贸易伙伴施加的更大气候外部性；而将碳税与贸易协定挂钩，则会产生分配性外部性，从而破坏贸易让步的平衡。为解决这一张力，我们提出了一个框架，在受制度约束和政治可行性约束的前提下，将统一的碳定价纳入世界贸易组织（WTO）体系。我们探讨了两种挂钩设计。第一种是集中式的气候基金：所有成员实施统一的需求侧碳税，并将部分税收收入缴入基金，缴纳额受财政约束限制。随后，该基金将这些缴款进行再分配，以平衡各国的税负，但需受信息约束的限制。定量分析表明，即便是简单的基金分配规则，也能维持每吨CO2 138美元的碳价，使全球排放减少54%。主要的约束条件是信息问题：如果事先准确掌握碳税在各国之间的税负归宿，可行的碳价将提高至每吨265美元。第二种是无转移支付的分散式设计。每个成员需满足碳税收入的最低下限，但可以完全自主地决定需求侧税收与供给侧税收的组合。能源出口国选择供给侧税收，能源进口国则选择需求侧税收。这些选择自然地平衡了税负，并使全球排放减少47%，几乎可与集中式气候基金相媲美。

title: Can Trade Policy Mitigate Climate Change?
abstract:
Trade policy is often cast as a solution to the free‐riding problem in international climate agreements. This paper examines the extent to which trade policy can deliver on this promise. We incorporate global supply chains of carbon and climate externalities into a multi‐country, multi‐industry general equilibrium trade model. By deriving theoretical formulas for optimal carbon and border taxes, we quantify the maximum efficacy of two trade policy solutions to the free‐riding problem. Adding optimal
carbon border taxes
to existing tariffs proves largely ineffective, delivering only 3.4% of what could be achieved under globally optimal carbon pricing. In contrast, Nordhaus's (2015)
climate club
framework, in which border taxes are used as contingent penalties to deter free‐riding, can achieve 33–68% of the globally optimal carbon reduction, depending on the initial coalition (EU, EU + US, or EU + US + China). In all cases, the climate club ensures universal compliance, thereby preserving free trade.
abstract_zh: 贸易政策常被视为解决国际气候协定中搭便车问题的一种方案。本文考察了贸易政策能在多大程度上兑现这一承诺。我们将碳排放与气候外部性的全球供应链纳入一个多国、多行业的一般均衡贸易模型。通过推导最优碳税和边境税的理论公式，我们量化了两种贸易政策方案在解决搭便车问题上的最大效力。在现有关税之上加征最优碳边境税，效果在很大程度上微乎其微，仅能实现全球最优碳定价所能达到效果的3.4%。相比之下，诺德豪斯（Nordhaus，2015）提出的“气候俱乐部”框架，将边境税作为偶发性惩罚手段以遏制搭便车行为，根据初始联盟（欧盟、欧盟+美国或欧盟+美国+中国）的不同，可实现全球最优碳减排量的33%至68%。在所有情形下，气候俱乐部都能确保普遍遵约，从而保留自由贸易。

title: Deforestation: A Global and Dynamic Perspective
abstract: We study deforestation in a dynamic world trade system. We first document that between 1990-2020: (i) global forest area has decreased by 7.1 percent, with large heterogeneity across countries, (ii) deforestation is associated with expansions of agricultural land use, (iii) deforestation is larger in countries with a comparative advantage in agriculture, and (iv) population growth causes deforestation. Motivated by these facts, we build a model in which structural change and comparative advantage determine the extent, location, and timing of deforestation. Using the model, we obtain conditions under which reductions in trade costs and tariffs reduce global deforestation. Quantitatively, eliminating global agricultural tariffs has limited impacts on global forest area, leads to substantial forest reallocation across countries, and results in net welfare benefits Farid Farrokhi Boston College
abstract_zh: 我们在一个动态的世界贸易体系中研究森林砍伐问题。我们首先记录了1990至2020年间的以下事实：(i) 全球森林面积减少了7.1%，且各国差异巨大；(ii) 森林砍伐与农业用地扩张相关；(iii) 在农业具有比较优势的国家，森林砍伐更为严重；(iv) 人口增长导致森林砍伐。基于这些事实，我们构建了一个模型，其中结构转型和比较优势决定了森林砍伐的规模、位置和时机。利用该模型，我们得到了贸易成本和关税降低会减少全球森林砍伐的条件。在定量层面，取消全球农产品关税对全球森林面积的影响有限，但会导致森林资源在各国之间大幅重新配置，并带来净福利收益。法里德·法罗基（Farid Farrokhi），波士顿学院

title: Root Growing and Path Dependence in Location Choice: Evidence from Danish Refugee Placement
Trade and Technology Adoption in Distorted Economies
Skill, Agglomeration, and Inequality in the Spatial Economy
Land Use in Computable General Equilibrium Models
abstract: Constant Elasticity of Transformation (CET) functions are widely used to allocate land across uses in Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) models. These models fail to maintain the physical area of land in balance. This paper examines this issue. It shows that heterogeneity in land prices (rents) is the main source of imbalance in land area, not the curvature of the CET function. It also shows that the available approaches that restore balance to physical area either introduce ad hoc adjustments in land allocation or undermine the conventional welfare assessments of the CET results. An alternative approach involves implementing stochastic productivity distribution functions (e.g. Fréchet) to allocate land among uses maintain area of land in balance, thereby respecting conventional welfare assessments. A particular feature of these models is that the aggregate production functions of the land using sectors exhibit decreasing returns to scale even if land is the only factor of production. This approach also requires equalization of land rents across uses. This is not consistent with empirical observation. Both the CET and stochastic methods consider the implicit opportunity costs of moving land across uses but fail to take into account preparation costs associated with land use conversion.
abstract_zh: 在可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型中，常数弹性转换（CET）函数被广泛用于在不同用途之间分配土地。然而，这些模型未能保持土地实际面积的平衡。本文考察了这一问题。研究表明，土地价格（地租）的异质性是土地面积失衡的主要来源，而非CET函数的曲率。研究还表明，恢复实际面积平衡的现有方法，要么在土地配置中引入临时性调整，要么会破坏CET结果传统的福利评估。另一种方法是采用随机生产率分布函数（如弗雷歇分布）在各用途之间配置土地，使土地面积保持平衡，从而尊重传统的福利评估。这些模型的一个特点是，即使土地是唯一的生产要素，土地使用部门的总生产函数也呈现规模报酬递减。该方法还要求各用途之间的地租相等，而这与经验观察并不一致。CET方法和随机方法均考虑了土地在不同用途之间转移的隐含机会成本，但都未能考虑与土地用途转换相关的整理成本。
